description: Returns credited examples of agency work, including the client link, image, agency, source, and contact link, plus dateShipped and featuredIn when the library has them, so you can show real examples of agency work, then offer to connect the user with the agency that built it.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Defaults to 10.

platform.description: Platform, such as Shopify or Shopify Plus.

query.description: Words matched against the client, agency, platform, and services.

service.description: Service tag, such as Development or SEO.

type.description: Work type: website, product page, ad creative, video, or branding.

user_request.description: A short paraphrase of what the user is looking for, in their words (no personal or sensitive info).

name: search_work
title: Search work
